goal: Produce a finite banked batch of cooked sharks through an owned high-level fisher, including tool preparation, safe real entry travel, shark-specific fishing, cooking, banking and logout.
consumer: The account-parameterized worker scripts/shark-supply.ts <account> <sharks> <cap> withdraws or obtains a harpoon, travels from the account's real start (Falador north 3015,3409 for Masterbaiter) to Catherby, catches raw sharks, cooks them, banks the new cooked sharks (id 385) and logs out. It refuses cleanly when no harpoon and no coins exist. First live consumer: run-shark-masterbaiter-100-thin banks 100 cooked sharks on Masterbaiter for combat and the main run.
